jobs.description:
We are urgently looking for motivated reach truck drivers who can start as soon as possible. In this role, you will combine operating a reach truck with manual warehouse tasks. A varied position for someone who enjoys staying active and getting things done!

Your responsibilities:

• Moving and storing goods using a reach truck.

• Carrying out manual warehouse tasks.

• Assisting with loading, unloading and moving goods.

• Helping to maintain a clean, organised and safe warehouse.

• Alternating between reach truck operations and physical manual work.

• You will ensure the smooth and accurate handling of goods in the warehouse.

• You will work in schedules in early or late shifts.

We are looking for someone with experience operating a reach truck who is not afraid of hands-on manual work.

• You have a valid reach truck certificate.

• You have experience operating a reach truck.

• You speak and understand English well. This is a requirement.

• You are willing to combine reach truck operations with manual warehouse tasks.

• You are motivated, flexible and have a hands-on attitude.

• Having your own transport is an advantage.

Department of Biomedical Sciences – Trypanosoma Unit 
 

For a more detailed research context, please refer to the PDF document.
 

Your role:
 

 · Develop an innovative and internationally competitive research programme on trypanosomes, with a strong foundation in fundamental parasite biology and/or host–parasite–vector interactions.
 

· Develop, apply and disseminate state-of-the-art experimental approaches in fundamental research, which may include advanced molecular biology, biochemistry, imaging, cell biology, multi-omics and/or computational methods, according to the candidate’s expertise and research interest.
 

· Be willing to take responsibility for and further develop the unit’s existing translational and applied research portfolio, including its contribution to HAT diagnosis, molecular surveillance and control programmes, as well as the scientific use and maintenance of its tsetse fly facility.
 

· Establish and foster strong global partnerships and collaborations.
 

· Acquire competitive research funding and build up international reputation and visibility.
 

· Contribute actively to the development and delivery of the educational portfolio of the Department of Biomedical Sciences and ITM, including supervision of Master students and PhD training.
 

· Build and lead a team of scientific and technical staff, take up management responsibilities appropriate to the academic level.
 

· Collaborate with other units in the Department of Biomedical Sciences and ITM to develop complementary research lines on vector-borne and protozoan diseases.
 

· Contribute expertise to national and international bodies and stakeholders, where relevant to the candidate’s field.
 

· Oversee and direct ITM’s WHO Collaborating Centre for Research and Training on Human African Trypanosomiasis Diagnostics.
 

· Promote and contribute to the strategic vision of the department and to relevant ITM committees.

Profile / Requirements
 

· A PhD degree in biology, veterinary sciences, biomedical sciences, biochemistry, medicine, or equivalent field. 
 

· An excellent research profile in experimental/molecular parasitology of Trypanosomatids. 
 

· Experience with advanced experimental and/or computational approaches relevant to the proposed research programme. 
 

· A proven track record of successful grant writing and project supervision, in accordance with the candidate’s career stage. 
 

· A collaborative scientific profile and ability to develop interdisciplinary and international collaborations. 
 

· Experience in translational or applied research, capacity strengthening, and collaboration with institutions in endemic countries is considered an asset. 
 

· Prior experience in running a tsetse fly facility is not essential, though an interest in helping to run and utilize the tsetse facilities is considered an asset. 
 

· Experience in academic teaching and training in the field of parasitology is highly valued. 
 

· Excellent communication skills and respectful people management skills. 
 

· Fluent in English. Knowledge of French is an asset. Active knowledge of Dutch is desirable. If you do not have these skills, willingness to acquire a working level of Dutch is requested. 
 

· You support the mission and values of the ITM.

You will start up the production process, operate the machines, and oversee smooth operations. In case of malfunctions, you will troubleshoot them or call in a technician. You follow the production planning and ensure efficient communication with colleagues. Additionally, you actively participate on the production floor.

What are we looking for?

• You are able to work very independently
• You have a strong sense of responsibility and know how to take action
• You have some technical insight
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts
• It is a plus if you can operate a forklift

To support our further growth ambitions, brantsandpatents is looking for
 a Patent Advisor or (partially qualified) European Patent Attorney with a background in chemistry, preferable organic chemistry.
 

As a Patent Advisor, you will analyze the R&D activities of your clients and advise them on how to protect their innovations through an appropriate IP strategy, which you will then put into practice.
 

Within the patent department, you will work with other patent advisors, -attorneys and patent paralegals. In this varied role, you will be responsible for mapping (technical) inventions, drafting patent applications, and managing and guiding the patent portfolios of clients.
 

You will keep an eye on competing innovations and advise on potential conflicts when necessary. You will also proactively propose solutions. You will represent your clients before the Belgian Intellectual Property Office and the European Patent Office.
 

You’ll work from our office in Ghent.
 

 

You have or are...
 
 

• A master’s degree (MSc) in chemistry, chemical engineering or similar, with a strong preference for organic chemistry. A PhD is a nice to have. 

• Strong analytical skills and a results-oriented, quality-driven approach. 

• A client-driven mindset. 

• Fluent in Dutch with a good knowledge of English. 

• Interest in legal principles and patent law. 

• The ambition and drive to build a career in IP and to qualify as a patent attorney.

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

We are looking for a senior developer who will take ownership of designing and building high-quality, well-tested software solutions within the Transport Execution Management domain. You will work closely with the solution designer and business stakeholders to translate ideas into effective, reliable applications, gaining a deep understanding of the business context along the way.

Beyond strong technical expertise, we are looking for someone who shows initiative, communicates clearly, contributes actively to the team, and is willing to go the extra mile when needed. You are respectful and calm in your interactions. Independence is key in this role: taking full responsibility for delivering complete solutions is part of your daily work. At the same time, you value teamwork and knowledge sharing. In line with the Pros values of SNCB, you bring professionalism and a constructive attitude that helps the team move forward.

• .NET development: Over 10 years of experience

• Azure Cloud development: Over 5 years of experience

• .NET Core Web API development: Over 5 years of experience

• .NET for Android (Xamarin): Over 5 years of experience

• Blazor: At least 2 year of experience

• Professional expertise in unit testing

• Fluent in English (C2)

• On-site presence: Up to 20 business days on site at the Ypto office in Brussels during the assignment. The required on-site presence will be determined by Ypto based on business needs.

Evaluation criteria

The extent to which the proposal demonstrates the required competencies and complies with the stated requirements will be taken into account during the evaluation. Proposals that demonstrate these competencies and requirements more clearly, comprehensively, and convincingly will receive a higher score. Where specific experience is requested, a greater amount of demonstrable relevant experience will result in a higher evaluation score.

• .NET development - demonstrates deep mastery of the .NET ecosystem: language features, LINQ, async/await, security practices, and selecting appropriate data structures and patterns.

• Android - Working experience developing complex native .NET for Android / Xamarin applications. deep mastery of the Android lifecycle, native binding.

• Code quality & craftsmanship - writes clean, maintainable, and SOLID code that follows best practices.

• Web API design & development - designs secure, performant .NET Core Web APIs.

• Azure cloud - leverages Azure services, PaaS components, and event-driven patterns effectively.

• Unit testing & test quality - creates meaningful, maintainable, and automated unit tests.

• CI/CD & DevOps practices - sets up robust Azure DevOps pipelines and manages containerized deployments with Kubernetes & Docker.

• SQL & database design - models, queries, and optimizes relational databases.

• GIT & Version Control - applies branching strategies and collaborates efficiently using GIT.

• Collaboration & communication - proven ability to explain technical choices clearly, work constructively in a team, and retain a professional posture in stressful situations or environments.

jobs.occupation: Internal Sales Officer | Temporary | 6 months | full-time | Mechelen
jobs.description:
Are you highly organized, analytically minded, and comfortable working in an international environment? We are currently looking for an Internal Sales Officer Europe to join a dynamic sales organization on a temporary replacement assignment and play a key role in supporting commercial operations.

Your Responsibilities: 

 
• In this role, you will support day-to-day commercial activities and ensure the smooth follow-up of customer and sales processes. 
 
• Manage customer and product registration processes 
 
• Process pricing agreements and upload data into the ERP system 
 
• Follow-up on orders in close collaboration with Customer Service 
 
• Maintain daily contact with customers regarding operational matters 
 
• Monitor and maintain forecast data 
 
• Analyze sales figures and report deviations 
 
• Explain increases or decreases in volumes and revenue 
 
• Collaborate closely with various internal departments, including Marketing, Customer Service, and Documentation 
 
• Prepare forecast meetings and collect relevant information for management reporting 
 
• Support after-sales activities and customer follow-up 

 
• You work in a structured and accurate manner 
 
• You are proactive and comfortable taking initiative 
 
• You communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders 
 
• You possess strong analytical skills 
 
• You have a good knowledge of Excel 
 
• Experience with SAP is a strong asset 
 
• You have an excellent command of English, both written and spoken

Responsibilities:   

 
•  
You support the development, optimization and management of technical products and solutions.
 
 
•  
You apply standards, guidelines and certification requirements, and support approval processes.
 
 
•  
You work closely with customers and translate their needs into technical solutions.
 
 
•  
You create and modify technical designs in CAD and manage the associated product data.
 
 
•  
You collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Production and Quality to address technical questions and challenges.
 

Required qualifications:   

 
•  
Master's degree in Electromechanics, supplemented with initial work experience.
 
 
•  
Practical knowledge of 3D CAD and MS Office.
 
 
•  
Strong motivation and willingness to deepen your knowledge of standards, regulations and certifications.
 
 
•  
Willingness to travel within Europe and the US.
 
 
•  
Analytical mindset and ability to critically assess technical data.
 
 
•  
Strong interpersonal skills and a good command of English.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
Our client is an established family-owned company with more than 30 years of experience in the food industry, specialized in the production and processing of fresh potato products.

The company combines modern production technology with a strong focus on quality, hygiene and food safety. You will join a professional and dynamic production environment where teamwork, reliability and quality are key.

We are currently looking for an experienced and motivated Line Supervisor to join a production environment in the food industry. You will be responsible for the smooth operation of the production line and will help ensure that production runs safely, efficiently, and according to quality standards.

Your responsibilities:

 
• 
Start up and monitor the production line

 
• 
Coordinate the daily activities on the production line

 
• 
Operate and supervise production equipment

 
• 
Identify and resolve minor operational issues

 
• 
Ensure quality, safety, and hygiene standards are followed

 
• 
Work closely with operators and other production colleagues

 
• 
Operate a forklift when required

 
• 
Previous experience as a production operator; experience as a Line Supervisor / Line Leader is a strong advantage

 
• 
Forklift experience

 
• 
Willingness to work in the food production industry

 
• 
Strong sense of responsibility and ability to take the lead on the production line

 
• 
Very good command of English

 
• 
Willingness to work in a 2-shift system

What will you do?
 
 
 
• Picking and preparing various orders using a handheld scanner or voice picking system. 
 
• Checking, labeling, and securely packaging items. 
 
• Registering goods correctly in the system. 
 
• Contributing to the smooth and efficient operation of the warehouse. 
 
• You will work in a cold environment. 

Who are we looking for?
 
 
 
• You have experience as an order picker in a logistics environment. 
 
• You can start quickly and are motivated to learn. 
 
• You are flexible and willing to work in shifts (early-late, or night). 
 
• You speak and understand English well. 
 
• You have your own means of transportation.

For our client Kuehne + Nagel, a leading international logistics company, we are looking for motivated Order Pickers to strengthen their team. Are you accurate and interested in working in an international environment? Then this opportunity is for you!
 

What will you do?
 

 
• Carefully pick and prepare customer orders.
 
• Use a hand scanner to process goods.
 
• Check, label, and safely package products.
 
• Correctly register products in the system.
 
• Contribute to the smooth and efficient operation of the logistics flow. 

Who are we looking for?
 

 
• You have experience as an Order Picker.
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system. During busier periods, you may also be required to work on Saturdays.
 
• You can work independently but also function well as part of a team.
 
• You speak and understand Dutch or English well.
 
• You have your own transportation.

What does a reachtruckchauffeur do here? You keep goods flowing smoothly. As a reachtruckchauffeur, you move products, load and unload trucks, and prepare orders for shipping.

It’s a bit like being a traffic controller—but inside a warehouse. You’ll also check quality and keep things tidy and safe.

Are you the right reachtruckchauffeur? You have experience, a valid certificate, and feel confident on a reach truck.

As a reachtruckchauffeur, you’re flexible with shifts and communicate in English or Dutch.

You work accurately, safely, and like being part of a team.

Are you an experienced Java Developer looking for challenging enterprise projects where you can make a real impact?

At Inetum Belgium, we are looking for a Senior Java Developer with strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, Cloud technologies (Azure/AWS), and modern software engineering practices.

You will work on large-scale digital transformation projects, helping leading organizations design, develop and maintain scalable enterprise applications. Together with architects, analysts, developers and business stakeholders, you will contribute to innovative solutions that deliver real business value.

Forget about conventional communication styles, the main language we speak is Java. If you are passionate about backend development, cloud-native architectures, software craftsmanship and continuous learning, you might be the next Java expert Inetum Belgium is looking for. 

As a Medior - Senior Java Developer, you will:

• Develop, maintain and improve enterprise-grade Java applications.
• Design and implement scalable backend solutions using Java and the Spring ecosystem.
• Build and maintain RESTful APIs and integration services.
• Contribute to microservices and event-driven architectures.
• Collaborate with architects, analysts and development teams on complex cross-project initiatives.
• Participate actively in Agile and Scrum ceremonies.
• Identify opportunities for technical improvements and software optimization.
• Take ownership of software quality through unit testing, integration testing and code reviews.
• Ensure the delivery of well-designed, maintainable, testable and efficient code.
• Support and coach junior developers when needed.
• Contribute to development standards, best practices and technical documentation.

Required

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in Java Development, with expertise in backend and/or full stack application development.
• Proven experience designing, developing and maintaining enterprise-scale software solutions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Experience working in Agile development environments.
• Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Technical Skills & Experience

• Java (Java 8/11/17+)
• Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data & Spring Security
• REST APIs, SOAP, XML & JSON Integrations
• Microservices & Event-Driven Architectures
• Hibernate & JPA
• Maven & Gradle
• Azure and/or AWS
• Enterprise Application Servers (JBoss, WildFly, WebSphere, Oracle Middleware)
• Tomcat and similar runtimes
• CI/CD & DevOps Practices
• Automated Testing & Software Quality
• Agile & Scrum Methodologies
• AI-Assisted Development (GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot)
• Fluent English
• Professional working proficiency in Dutch and/or French

Responsibilities

• Analyze and translate business requirements and processes into detailed functional specifications for (Gen)AI topics.
• Design end-to-end solutions that are cost-efficient and meet specific customer needs.
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver value through an iterative and MVP-driven approach.
• Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical profiles to ensure alignment on automation topics.
• Challenge requirements and specifications to ensure optimal solution design and rapid time-to-market.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in functional analysis for Generative AI implementations in corporate settings.
• 3+ years of experience with AWS and Azure AI technologies.
• 3+ years of experience with Python scripting.
• 3+ years of domain expertise within the energy sector.
• You have experience working with Agile and MVP methodologies.
• You possess strong analytical skills and the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
• You are fluent in English, French, and Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with process engineering or marketing automation.

jobs.occupation: UX Designer & Researcher – Figma & Design Thinking
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Lead UX research activities and manage the research repository to document user insights.
• Facilitate functional framing workshops, ideation sessions, and co-design activities with stakeholders and end-users.
• Collect user feedback and identify pain points through interviews, on-site observations, and user tests.
• Analyze user behavior and platform performance using tools like Matomo and heatmaps.
• Create wireframes, prototypes, user flows, and site maps to communicate interaction and design concepts.
• Collaborate with UI designers to ensure overall consistency with the established design system.

Requirements

• You have 5+ years of experience in design thinking within agile project environments.
• You possess 5+ years of experience with qualitative and quantitative research methods.
• You bring 3+ years of experience in interaction design and information architecture.
• You're proficient in creating lo-fidelity wireframes and prototypes using Figma.
• You possess experience with analysis and collaboration tools such as Matomo, Miro, and PowerPoint.
• You hold a formal qualification or certification in UX.
• You possess a proactive and resilient attitude with strong facilitation and workshop management skills.
• You are fluent in English with a good level of Dutch and/or French.
Nice to Haves

• Ability to utilize design systems in Figma.
• Knowledge of the research tool Condens.
• Professional knowledge of German.
